primitives.name: Edge-Augmented Cross-Attention
primitives.verbatim_quote: We introduce a learnable data association module based on edge-augmented cross-attention, leveraging appearance and geometric features.
primitives.assumptions: The method assumes that object associations can be modeled through weighted graph edges derived from appearance and geometric feature similarities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when attention normalization disproportionately favors noisy or incorrect associations, leading to tracking errors.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI conformal prediction intervals via kernel density estimation of association uncertainties.
layer2.telemetry: Association uncertainty quantiles derived from edge attention scores.

primitives.name: Auxiliary Token Mitigation
primitives.verbatim_quote: We also propose an auxiliary token in this attention-based association module, which helps mitigate disproportionately high attention to incorrect association targets caused by attention normalization.
primitives.assumptions: Introduces a learnable bias term that stabilizes the softmax distribution over association candidates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when the auxiliary token becomes redundant or when the model overfits to its own parameters.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition models as a noise-resilient gating mechanism.
layer2.telemetry: Auxiliary token weight variance as a proxy for tracking robustness.

primitives.name: Alternating Detection and Association
primitives.verbatim_quote: We evaluate our method on the nuScenes dataset and demonstrate the advantage of our approach compared to the two previous paradigms.
primitives.assumptions: Iteratively updates track and detection queries within a shared transformer architecture, exploiting complementary information flow.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when alternating steps lead to gradient vanishing or divergence due to mismatched learning rates.

layer2.mapping: Dual to GSI sequential Monte Carlo resampling, where detection queries act as particles and association queries as weights.
layer2.telemetry: Query feature space entropy reduction per decoding step.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is fusing detection and association in a unified framework. Edge-Augmented Cross-Attention constructs a graph where nodes represent objects and edges encode similarity metrics. The auxiliary token stabilizes the attention distribution, preventing catastrophic forgetting of correct associations. Stacking multiple layers implements an alternating minimization scheme: first, track queries are updated via self-attention and image features to improve detection confidence; then, detection queries are refined via edge-augmented attention to strengthen inter-frame correspondences. This iterative refinement exploits the duality between sparse set prediction and dynamic optimal transport, yielding a robust solver for the MOT objective.
